system.description: Whenever you cleave through an enemy with Slicemaster, add 1D10 damage to the next target. Increase damage dealt this way to 2D6 at level 11. [3] Hack ‘n’ SlashA: (Prerequisite: Slicemaster, Power 5). Up to once per turn, expend a number of AP up to half your Proficiency (rounded up) in a consistent attack against a single target using a slashing divine weapon. Instead of gaining advantage on to-hit, increase the damage dice by 1 dice type for each AP expended this way if you hit.
